senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; חָבַל)rope, a measure of dimensions, rope’s length.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 93:4">Gen. R. s. 93</cite> <he>קשר ח׳ בח׳</he> tied rope to rope, v. <cite ref="N00673"><he>נִימָא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:8">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 5:4">Erub. V, 4</cite> <he>וכ׳ אין מודדין אלא בח׳</he> Sabbath distances must be measured with a rope of fifty cubits’ length. Ib. 58ᵃ, v. <cite ref="A02764"><he>אַפְסְקִימָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 7:2">B. Bath. VII, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Batra 103b:4">103ᵇ</cite>) <he>מדה בח׳</he> measured with the rope (exact dimensions).
Peah IV, 5 על הח׳ in a straight line, v. לָקַט; a. fr.—Pl. חֲבָלִים. Erub. l. c. ג׳ ח׳ הם וכ׳ there are three kinds of ropes (used for legal purposes).—Trnsf. share, possession.
Sifré Deut. 312 אין ח׳ אלא גורל ḥebel means lot; a. e.
